notes: Variant WLC.PSA.49.14.v001 covers s018-s020; underdetermined, projection carries the base reading and the ASV's beauty is aligned against it. The לְ before the infinitive takes shall be for as prepositional predicate (rule 49) and the infinitive keeps to consume since the preposition has spent its word (rule 52); giving the lamed to instead was the alternative. Privative מִן takes That no (rule 48).
